THE PARTNERSHIP

What we're proposing.

You told us you're looking for ways to modernize the facility. This is one that costs the arena nothing and pays it every month.

We install and own the screens. We sell, produce and service the advertising on them. You provide the wall space and the power — and take a share of everything that runs.

It's the same structure Tupelo Regional Airport's board approved in March. Those screens went live in April.

PROOF · SAME MARKET, SAME STRUCTURE

We just did this at Tupelo Regional.

In March, the Tupelo Airport Authority board reviewed and approved our Venue Partner Agreement — the same 60/40 origination split, content-approval process and grandfathering language we're offering you. Legal had no changes.

Exceed Technologies handled the install. Five screens now run across the lobby, center lobby, ticket counter, baggage claim and the sterile corridor. They came online cleanly, sit on the terminal's UPS and generator backing, and run 24/7.

MCTV carries general liability with the Authority named as an additional insured, primary and non-contributory, with notice of cancellation. We'd do the same for the Arena.

THE ECONOMICS

Sixty / forty. Whoever brings the advertiser.

Every advertiser on your screens pays a monthly rate, and that rate splits 60/40 in favor of whoever brought them in.

We go find an advertiser, you take 40% of them for doing nothing. You bring one — a sponsor, a vendor, someone already renting your building — and you take 60%. Your existing sponsor relationships are suddenly worth more than they were.

We still produce, bill and service every spot either way. Paid monthly with a report of what ran and what it billed. No minimums, no clawbacks — an empty screen costs you nothing.

Existing advertiser relationships are grandfathered on both sides. Anything the Arena has already sold stays 100% yours.

THE OTHER HALF OF THE DEAL

Your calendar, on every screen we own.

The screens in your building are only half of it. The bigger asset is the other 125+ — every clinic waiting room, gym, salon and restaurant in Tupelo, Oxford and the Golden Triangle where we already run.

We put your event calendar on all of them. Every show, every on-sale, every conference booking window, in front of roughly 1.9 million monthly impressions of the exact people you're trying to get through the doors.

You're currently buying that reach. As a host, you'd have it.

And in your own lobby: an airport-style board showing what's on now, what's next, and which room — live off your calendar, Central time, with private bookings masked automatically. Built for the Oxford Conference Center. Yours at no cost.

NEXT STEPS

How this actually happens.

Start to finish, comparable venues have gone from first walkthrough to live screens in about thirty days. Nothing below asks the Arena for a dollar.

01
Walkthrough & screen survey
We walk the arena and conference center with you, agree the placements and the count. About an hour of your time.
02
Venue Partner Agreement & COI
The same document the Airport Authority's board approved. The Arena is named as an additional insured on our general liability policy.
03
Equipment & install
Ordered on execution. Installed by Exceed Technologies, scheduled around your event calendar.
04
Content build
We build your Arena spots and the lobby event board. Nothing goes on screen without your approval.
05
Live — and earning
Screens run 24/7. Your first revenue-share report follows the first month of billing.
